dedupe_keys.name: high power battery cell cycling and temperature characterization

description: The high-power battery research team publishes cell characterization tests for stochastic battery modelling through a public OSF project. Coverage is a tested high-power cell family and its laboratory conditions. The file listing exposes a dataset folder and a large ZIP. The describing article details charging and discharge experiments, voltage and current traces, impedance tests and temperature conditions of five, twenty-five and forty degrees Celsius. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-28; obtaining it is free of charge. These observations can calibrate cell-level state and variability assumptions in battery-storage simulations, with model-pypsa offering a related grid-study context. A caveat is that one tested cell family and laboratory protocol do not represent all vehicle packs or stationary installations. Test phase labels, sampling and degradation histories must be checked before parameter estimation. The node and file listing were opened, but neither the archive nor individual measurement rows were downloaded.
